asset_set: Questionnaire Q12 option 1 — Leading corporate negotiations

questionnaire.question_text: Which office role fits you better?

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under handshake and table edge — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; subtle paper-grain suggestion on contract via 3 parallel lines max
art_style.mood: confident boardroom energy — approachable business deal-making, not a cold corporate stock photo
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops only
color.accent_rule: coral appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlights on clasped knuckles and watch face
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under handshake and table objects

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: extends into a firm handshake grip
left_hand.grip: full palm clasp, thumb wrapped over the other hand
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: meets the handshake to close the deal
right_hand.position: center-right, meeting at the handshake point

pose.gesture_summary: mid-handshake freeze frame — a deal being sealed over the contract
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

top.sleeve_style: rolled once to mid-forearm, sharp crease

subject.scene_narrative: Two forearms meet in a firm handshake directly above an open contract on a minimal boardroom table. A yellow pen rests uncapped beside the signature line, and a wristwatch glints on one arm. The gesture captures the exact instant a deal is sealed — confident, mutual, and forward-looking rather than tense.

primary_objects.name: contract document
primary_objects.detail: open double-page spread with faint ruled lines, no readable text

primary_objects.name: pen
primary_objects.detail: uncapped, tip pointing toward the signature line

primary_objects.name: conference table edge
primary_objects.detail: simple flat plank, subtle grain lines

subject.environment: warm wood boardroom table strip across bottom third — fades to transparent at edges

composition.layout: centered handshake meeting point with contract fanned beneath
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 48px safe zone for card crop
depth_layers: background: table edge only — no wall
composition.thumbnail_readability: handshake silhouette + contract shape readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, corporate brand, letter E, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, aggressive body language, guns, blood

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector illustration, 640x640, transparent PNG background. KursoKo quiz choice for "Leading corporate negotiations". Style: flat vector, 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, solid fills, minimal cel shadow under hands — matches KursoKo RIASEC sticker family, NO letter, NO border frame, NO text on image. Scene: two forearms meet in a firm handshake above an open contract on a wood boardroom table. A yellow #FFD54F pen rests uncapped beside the page. Structured navy blazer sleeves rolled to mid-forearm with coral #FF8A65 cuff trim, brushed gold wristwatch on one arm. Warm medium skin tone #C8956C. Three-quarter top-down camera, hands in lower half, transparent margins. Mood: confident, decisive deal-closing energy.
